source: Bray, D., & von Storch, H. (2016). The Bray and von Storch 5th International Survey of Climate Scientists 2015/2016. HZG Report 2016-2 (hereon.de copy, hzg_report_2016_2.pdf), figures 1–9 and 21, pages 24–32 and 44 of the PDF.
subgroup_definitions: The report's four box plots per question (p. 19): 'climate science' = respondents whose work is directly in the production of knowledge concerning climate change (atmospheric or oceanic modelling, measurement and observation, downscaling, physical processes, palaeoclimatology); 'affiliated science' = socio-economic or ecological impact assessment, adaptation, science-policy administration and other climate-related work; each split by whether the respondent claimed to have been affiliated with the IPCC. 'Other – non-climate related' (6 respondents) is omitted. The n for each subgroup is printed on the figure page and recorded here.
method: The box plots carry no numbers. Each figure page was rendered from the PDF's vector content in a browser (pdf.js, scale 4 and 12) and the box plots read programmatically: the x axis was calibrated from the tick labels' positions (values 1–7, or 1–5 for figure 21), each subgroup's row located from its label, and the vertical lines (box edges and median), whisker caps and outlier dots located from the column-darkness profile of the row and mapped to the nearest half-unit. Because responses are integers, quartiles and medians are integers or half-integers and the mapping is exact. Checks: the whole-sample box plot of each figure agrees with the quartiles computed from the figure's printed histogram percentages (recorded as whole_sample_quartiles_from_histogram); the whiskers agree with the 1.5 × IQR rule given the box and the outliers. Limit: when a subgroup's median coincides with a box edge, the figure draws one line over another; where the overlap thickened the line (line-weight test at scale 12: 9 px against 6) the median is given as that edge, and where it did not the median is given as 'a or b'. Whisker values are None where the box is degenerate (all three quartiles equal).
